## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope is bounded and falsifiable enough for its current lifecycle stage
- [ ] Material factual claims have appropriate sources
- [ ] Uncertainty and counterevidence are visible
- [ ] Relevant structured reviews and disagreements are visible
- [ ] Risks, equity, misuse, and reversibility are addressed proportionately
- [ ] Status promotion, if any, is justified narratively under `docs/triage.md`
- [ ] No agent is treated as the decision authority
